name: A fragment under the Steamvault

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

summary: The second container is found in the Steamvault beneath Coilfang Reservoir. Khadgar recalls hiding it under Serpent Lake before the place was known by that name; he suspects the naga’s great drain carried it into the reservoir. That explanation is his best account of a changed landscape, not a witnessed transfer. The fragment is recovered, while the precise course of its movement remains uncertain.
